scenes.title: Three markers, first Dec 2
scenes.note: three numbered marker posts rise in a receding line on 'Three markers' (camera cranes with them); marker 1's disc flips to a red DEC 2 on 'December 2nd'

scenes.title: What Dec 2 should fill
scenes.hero: S18 cabinet with three DEC 2 tags
scenes.note: S18's cabinet back on its seats with its empty cavities; a red DEC 2 tag slides in and seats in each cavity on its item (rates by arm, event count, high/low-grade); push-in on the third

scenes.title: Then the two filings
scenes.note: the two application binders drop and squash together on 'two filings' (camera cranes); BY END OF MARCH 2027 and Q2 2027 drop under them on 'dates the company'

scenes.title: A filing is not an approval
scenes.hero: FDA plinth with the APPROVAL stamp
scenes.note: a FILING binder drops; on 'not an approval' the FDA plinth rises with the red APPROVAL stamp resting on it, unused; push-in on 'decision'
